newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Pakhoed to issue preference shares.
newsitem.headline: Pakhoed to issue preference shares.

text.p: Dutch tank storage and shipping group Pakhoed NV said on Monday it would issue up to 16 million preference shares at 12.50 guilders per share.
Investors may each subscribe to no fewer than 50,000 and no more than 5,300,000 depositary receipts, Pakhoed said.
The registered depositary receipts of cumulative financing preference shares have limited exchangeability.
The subscription list is only open at ING Bank NV in Amsterdam, and closes at 12 noon on November 29, 1996.
Payments must be made by December 4, 1996.
The depositary receipts will not be listed.
In June the firm said it planned to finance its takeover of US chemicals distributor Univar Corp partly through an issue of preference shares. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000
